answer: Copied credentials cannot certify the same irrigation cut twice. I bond 29.4 POA on plot TR-6 for 47 minutes and cut a 1.8 m irrigation terrace at 2.4 percent grade. A 300 mm still-water mirror on the berm must stay level within 1.2 mm, and a 22 mm juniper witness peg is driven at chainage 6.5 m, then sawn flush so it cannot be reused. Peers recompute cut volume (0.86-0.94 m3) and peg hash; a grade miss over 0.15 percent, or a logged peg, slashes 65 percent and retires TR-6. If the berm slumps before minute 24, the remainder freezes 11 hours and a new plot is required, never the same peg.
